Class FhirQuantity

org.hl7.fhir.r4.model.Base

org.hl7.fhir.r4.model.Quantity
arztis.econnector.rest.model.fhir.FhirQuantity
All Implemented Interfaces:
ca.uhn.fhir.model.api.IElement, java.io.Serializable, org.hl7.fhir.instance.model.api.IBase, org.hl7.fhir.instance.model.api.IBaseDatatype, org.hl7.fhir.instance.model.api.IBaseElement, org.hl7.fhir.instance.model.api.IBaseHasExtensions, org.hl7.fhir.instance.model.api.ICompositeType, org.hl7.fhir.r4.model.ICoding
public class FhirQuantity
extends org.hl7.fhir.r4.model.Quantity
This class is a subclass of Quantity. Therefore it contains measured amount.
It contains functionalities for converting CDA R2 PQ and CDA R2 QTY into HL7 FHIR Quantity and vice versa.
Author:
Anna Jungwirth
